entries.title: How to create effective prompts with Veo 3

principles.claim: Shot framing, camera motion, lighting, location, action, and style are separate control dimensions.
principles.evidenceLocator: What to think about while writing prompts
principles.transferRule: Compile each selected dimension from the shot plan; omit dimensions that should remain model-flexible.

principles.claim: Audio cues can be explicit and separately described.
principles.evidenceLocator: Fuse visuals with sound design
principles.transferRule: Include provider audio only when audio_responsibility_plan assigns it; otherwise remove dialogue and music from the video prompt.

antiPatterns: style-only prompt without observable action
unassigned dialogue or music

entries.title: Image to Video Prompting Guide

principles.claim: The source image already establishes subject, composition, lighting, and style.
principles.evidenceLocator: Core prompt elements
principles.transferRule: Describe subject action, environmental motion, camera motion, timing, direction, and speed instead of redescribing the still.

principles.claim: Unwanted cuts can come from overloaded temporal instructions.
principles.evidenceLocator: FAQ: Why did I receive an unwanted cut
principles.transferRule: Keep one observable action per clip and add continuous seamless shot only when the edit plan needs one take.

antiPatterns: redescribing every visible detail
multiple scene changes inside one short clip
motion contradicting visual cues

entries.title: Camera Terms, Prompts, and Examples

principles.claim: Shot size and camera motion should be selected as story controls, not decorative adjectives.
principles.evidenceLocator: Shot sizes and framing; FAQ
principles.transferRule: Bind every camera term to shot purpose, revealed information, and final edit point.

antiPatterns: camera-term stacking without a reveal plan
static camera prompt without in-frame motion

entries.title: Intro to Shot Listing

principles.claim: A usable shot list includes shot size, lens, camera movement, scene action, and production context.
principles.evidenceLocator: Lesson 3: How to Populate a Shot List
principles.transferRule: Require narrative purpose and edit dependency in addition to technical shot specs before generation or shooting.

principles.claim: Shots should be organized around practical setups as well as story order.
principles.evidenceLocator: Course progression and shot-list workflow
principles.transferRule: Keep narrative order in the semantic timeline while grouping execution tasks by shared location, lighting, lens, or generation anchor.

antiPatterns: shot list as a list of pretty images
camera choice without coverage or edit purpose

entries.title: Make videos programmatically

principles.claim: Reusable compositions expose text, images, colors, timing, and layout as props.
principles.evidenceLocator: Create video apps and automations: Design a template
principles.transferRule: Render exact text, captions, charts, brand layout, and approved transitions deterministically from semantic timeline props.

principles.claim: Programmatic preview and rendering allow every frame to be inspected.
principles.evidenceLocator: Preview and render; Remotion Studio
principles.transferRule: Bind transitions and overlays to frame-accurate timing, then verify the exported media with the exhaustive frame audit.

antiPatterns: slideshow-only image replacement
unparameterized hard-coded one-off composition
showcase copying

entries.title: Veo first-and-last-frame and ingredients examples

principles.claim: First and last frames define two visual states while the prompt must define the physical and dramatic path between them.
principles.evidenceLocator: First and last frame examples
principles.transferRule: Author both boundary frames from the approved camera graph, then describe one continuous action and camera path whose ending pose is edit-ready.

principles.claim: Reference ingredients control recurring scene, character, and object identity.
principles.evidenceLocator: Ingredients to video examples
principles.transferRule: Assign each approved reference a named continuity role; never pass unrelated mood-board images as identity anchors.

antiPatterns: copying official demo composition
unreviewed reference images
boundary frames with no plausible motion path

entries.title: Continuity Editing: Eyeline, Axis, Angle and Matching Action

principles.claim: Maintaining one side of the action axis preserves left-right spatial relationships; a neutral shot, visible camera crossing, or cutaway can reset the axis.
principles.evidenceLocator: 180-degree rule and continuity techniques; Heat and 25th Hour examples
principles.transferRule: Block an unexplained screen-direction reversal, but allow an evidence-backed intentional break or visible axis reset and keep it visible in review.

principles.claim: Matching the phase and direction of an action across a cut creates seamless motion continuity.
principles.evidenceLocator: Matching action; Mad Max Fury Road example
principles.transferRule: Carry the outgoing action key and phase into the incoming prompt as a continuation; reject action-phase regression.

antiPatterns: unexplained axis reversal
same-direction dialogue eyelines
action restart after a match cut
copying film example footage

entries.title: Editing Rhythm Through Shot Duration and Emotional Contrast

principles.claim: Shot duration establishes a pace baseline and meaningful deviations create intensity, relief, or calm.
principles.evidenceLocator: Control the shot duration; Psycho shower sequence and long-take examples
principles.transferRule: Score duration relative to neighboring emotional energy and information load rather than enforcing one universal average shot length.

principles.claim: Editing rhythm should support the intended emotion and story before decorative tempo.
principles.evidenceLocator: Support the emotion and tone
principles.transferRule: Require a beat-level emotional target curve and repair flat or contradictory timing while allowing intentional stillness.

antiPatterns: uniform shot duration
fast cuts without information hierarchy
slow shots without internal composition change
copying a source sequence beat-for-beat

entries.title: Storyboard Camera Movement With Narrative Motivation

principles.claim: Storyboard camera movement needs both an explicit movement description and a legible visual direction.
principles.evidenceLocator: Clarify camera movement in the shot description; draw storyboard arrows
principles.transferRule: Store a named movement, direction, and narrative motivation for every moving-camera shot before provider prompting.

antiPatterns: camera movement as a generic quality adjective
movement with no reveal or subject relationship
stacking incompatible moves

entries.title: TransitionSeries: transitions, overlays, and deterministic duration

principles.claim: A Transition overlaps adjacent sequences and shortens the total composition duration by its own duration.
principles.evidenceLocator: TransitionSeries introduction and Duration of a TransitionSeries
principles.transferRule: Compile final timeline duration by subtracting every registered transition overlap and fail before render when it drifts from the approved semantic timeline.

principles.claim: An Overlay is centered around a cut and does not shorten adjacent scene durations.
principles.evidenceLocator: Overlay example and API
principles.transferRule: Use overlays only for approved cut-point effects and preserve the full duration of both scenes in the render contract.

antiPatterns: assuming transitions preserve total duration
using overlays as hidden scene replacements
transition longer than either adjacent scene
adjacent transition stacking

entries.title: Prompt to Motion Graphics: validation, narrow skills, sanitization, and preview

principles.claim: The official template validates requests and injects only the guidance and example skills relevant to the requested motion-graphics domain.
principles.evidenceLocator: README Architecture and How It Works: Validation and Skill Detection
principles.transferRule: Route each SceneSpec to the smallest approved Remotion pattern pack instead of exposing an unrestricted generic code prompt.

principles.claim: Generated Remotion code is treated as untrusted output and sanitized before live preview.
principles.evidenceLocator: README Architecture: Code Generation to Sanitization to Live Preview
principles.transferRule: Reject arbitrary imports, network effects, filesystem access, nondeterministic timers, and unregistered assets before generated motion code can reach Player or render.

antiPatterns: executing arbitrary generated React
injecting the whole knowledge library for every scene
treating a successful preview as final-media proof

entries.title: GPT Image 2 generation and editing contract

blockedReuse: example prompt copy as final creative

principles.claim: Image generation requests separate prompt intent from model, size, quality, format, background, and input-image controls.
principles.evidenceLocator: Image generation and image edit request parameters
principles.transferRule: Compile creative intent from typed Director X layers while keeping endpoint parameters and exact input-image roles outside prompt prose.

principles.claim: GPT Image supports one or more image inputs, while masks guide the first input image and do not guarantee pixel-exact boundaries.
principles.evidenceLocator: Edit images and Customize image output
principles.transferRule: Emit one edit target plus a closed invariant set, bind the mask to the first input explicitly, and score unintended changes outside the requested region.

antiPatterns: sending deprecated model parameters to GPT Image 2
changing multiple unrelated variables in one edit
assuming a semantic mask is a pixel lock
treating camera terms as guaranteed EXIF physics

entries.title: FLUX.2 structured prompting, references, typography, and color

principles.claim: FLUX.2 gives earlier prompt content more attention and supports structured JSON for complex production scenes.
principles.evidenceLocator: Prompt Structure and JSON Structured Prompting
principles.transferRule: Place invariant subject and product requirements before style detail; use structured fields only for complex multi-object or automated scenes.

principles.claim: Multi-reference editing works best when each input image has a declared role.
principles.evidenceLocator: Multi-Reference Image Editing and Best Practices Summary
principles.transferRule: Bind each audited reference to one of identity, product_geometry, layout, pose, style, palette, or lighting and reject role collisions.

antiPatterns: sending a negative prompt to FLUX.2
unlabeled multi-reference inputs
placing secondary style before the required subject
assuming hex colors guarantee final colorimetry

entries.title: Midjourney Style Reference and Omni Reference

principles.claim: Style References convey visual treatment while the text prompt should describe the desired content.
principles.evidenceLocator: Best Practices: focus on content, not instructions
principles.transferRule: Keep identity and product geometry out of the style reference role and compile style weight separately from content and continuity constraints.

principles.claim: Omni Reference controls a person or object but is model-version-specific and does not guarantee small identity or logo details.
principles.evidenceLocator: Omni Reference compatibility, best practices, and weight
principles.transferRule: Record the effective model version and reference weight, then review identity and product geometry independently instead of treating the reference as a hard lock.

antiPatterns: using a style reference as an identity anchor
assuming small logos or freckles will match
omitting the text prompt
ignoring version-specific compatibility

entries.title: Runway Gen-4.5 text and image to video prompting

principles.claim: Simple, direct, observable motion instructions are more controllable than abstract concepts or overloaded action lists.
principles.evidenceLocator: Prompting basics, prompt elements, and iteration guidance
principles.transferRule: Compile one primary subject action and one camera intention per short clip, then add scene motion only when it does not conflict.

principles.claim: Temporal order may be expressed as natural-language sequence or timestamped action beats.
principles.evidenceLocator: Sequential prompting in the Image to Video guide
principles.transferRule: Use timestamped beats only when the requested actions fit the selected duration; otherwise split the request into multiple shots.

antiPatterns: negative phrasing instead of a positive state
multiple scene changes in one short clip
re-describing an input image instead of motion
motion that contradicts cues in the input frame

entries.title: Luma Dream Machine keyframes and boundary-driven motion

principles.claim: Start and end keyframes define visual states while the prompt describes the motion between them.
principles.evidenceLocator: Using start and end keyframes
principles.transferRule: Store identity, pose, action phase, gaze, screen position, prop state, light direction, camera vector, and motion energy at both boundaries before generation.

principles.claim: Keyframe interpolation degrades when the requested state change is implausible for the clip duration.
principles.evidenceLocator: Keyframe workflow and extension examples
principles.transferRule: Insert an intermediate bridge frame or split the shot when the boundary difference exceeds a plausible physical path.

antiPatterns: two attractive but physically unrelated boundary frames
identity changes hidden inside interpolation
long extension chains without boundary review

entries.title: ABCDs of effective video advertising

principles.claim: Attention, Branding, Connection, and Direction are creative effectiveness dimensions rather than a mandatory four-part timeline.
principles.evidenceLocator: ABCD introduction and objective-specific sections
principles.transferRule: Annotate where each dimension is satisfied while preserving the active story structure and platform rhythm.

principles.claim: Brand recognition and the intended action should be deliberately designed rather than left to an isolated final card.
principles.evidenceLocator: Branding and Direction guidance
principles.transferRule: Bind brand and CTA functions to observable story beats, product use, sound, and final payoff without forcing repetitive logos.

antiPatterns: forcing ABCD into four equal time blocks
logo repetition without story relevance
CTA disconnected from the demonstrated payoff

entries.title: TikTok Creative Codes

principles.claim: Vertical framing, native pacing, safe areas, dynamic stimulation, and sound are considered during production rather than after reframing.
principles.evidenceLocator: TikTok-first, production principles, and creative structure
principles.transferRule: Compile platform-safe composition, first-frame content, caption placement, sound role, and native interaction into the Director and shot plan.

principles.claim: Hook, body, and close provide a useful short-video structure but are not a substitute for product-specific proof and story logic.
principles.evidenceLocator: Creative structure guidance
principles.transferRule: Use the structure as an audit scaffold and require every stimulation event to change information, emotion, or action.

antiPatterns: motion or sound added without narrative purpose
unsafe caption placement
copying a trend without audience or brand fit
treating platform examples as universal creative law

entries.title: Volvo Trucks: The Epic Split as a visible product proof event

principles.claim: One legible event can embody a product capability more convincingly than a list of feature claims.
principles.evidenceLocator: Official film: reveal of two reversing trucks and the completed split
principles.transferRule: Translate the approved product promise into one observable proof event with a clear setup, risk, execution, and payoff.

principles.claim: The film preserves attention through controlled reveal and visual clarity rather than constant cutting or feature narration.
principles.evidenceLocator: Official film progression and product reveal
principles.transferRule: Allow sustained shots when the internal action, uncertainty, and proof value continue to evolve; do not force uniform cut density.

antiPatterns: copying the celebrity or stunt
using danger as a generic attention device
imitating the composition and music
claiming a proof event without factual or production evidence

entries.title: Seeded randomness and deterministic Remotion rendering

principles.claim: Remotion provides seeded pseudo-random values because Math.random produces inconsistent frames during multithreaded rendering.
principles.evidenceLocator: random() API and Randomness notes
principles.transferRule: Derive every procedural seed from run, scene, and element identity and persist it in remotion_composition_spec.json.

principles.claim: A stable seed makes procedural values reproducible for the same render inputs.
principles.evidenceLocator: Determinism and seeds examples
principles.transferRule: Render the same bundle and resolved props twice before release; require exact frame hashes for deterministic DOM/SVG compositions or a declared bounded pixel delta for fixed WebGL compositions.

antiPatterns: Math.random in render code
Date.now or requestAnimationFrame as a timeline
unrecorded seeds
treating one successful preview as determinism evidence

entries.title: Gemini image generation, multi-reference roles, and iterative editing

principles.claim: Gemini image models expose different limits for total inputs, characters, objects, and style references.
principles.evidenceLocator: Generate images and model-specific reference-image limits
principles.transferRule: Store reference limits by exact model and role; validate identity, product, layout, and style bindings separately before request compilation.

principles.claim: Gemini supports conversational multi-turn image generation and editing while retaining prior context.
principles.evidenceLocator: Multi-turn image editing
principles.transferRule: Persist every accepted input/output hash and edit delta, and restart from the latest accepted baseline instead of chaining failed candidates.

antiPatterns: one generic max-reference count for every model
unlabeled multi-reference inputs
continuing edits from a rejected candidate
assuming generated typography is final legal artwork

entries.title: Directing commercials with story economy, action, and intentional silence

principles.claim: Commercial direction compresses story so that frames and actions must carry narrative or persuasive work.
principles.evidenceLocator: Director interviews on storytelling within commercial duration
principles.transferRule: Require every beat to change information, emotion, action, scale, risk, or consequence; remove beats that only decorate the timeline.

principles.claim: Absence of dialogue or score can itself create attention and emphasis.
principles.evidenceLocator: Director discussion of sound and quiet in commercial work
principles.transferRule: Give silence an explicit story purpose and time range; distinguish intentional quiet from missing narration, music, or SFX in review.

antiPatterns: compressing a long master by cutting meaning
continuous music with no dramatic role
camera movement chosen only because it looks expensive
brand appearing only as a disconnected final logo

entries.title: Audio analysis and frame-driven visual response in Remotion

principles.claim: Remotion exposes decoded audio data and frequency visualization for frame-accurate audio-reactive graphics.
principles.evidenceLocator: Audio visualization APIs and frequency-bin examples
principles.transferRule: Build visual response from decoded RMS, frequency bands, onset and speech activity instead of random or decorative waveforms.

principles.claim: Frequency data can be transformed independently for different visual responsibilities.
principles.evidenceLocator: visualizeAudio() usage and smoothing examples
principles.transferRule: Assign bass, mids, highs, onset and speech-active signals to different layers with bounded amplitude and attack/release smoothing.

antiPatterns: fake random waveform
every layer reacting with identical amplitude
music-driven motion obscuring narration
unbounded visual jitter

entries.title: Remotion Recorder as a truthful product-demo capture route

principles.claim: The official Recorder template combines screen or camera capture, captions, music, editing and rendering.
principles.evidenceLocator: Template feature summary and repository link
principles.transferRule: Use real recordings for factual product behavior and reserve React reconstructions for explanation, privacy-safe emphasis or clearly labeled illustrative states.

principles.claim: Recorded media remains editable and can be composed with deterministic layers.
principles.evidenceLocator: Recorder editing and rendering workflow
principles.transferRule: Organize UI demos around result, trigger action, active region, state change and verified outcome rather than a tour of unrelated pages.

antiPatterns: redrawn UI presented as real proof
cursor wandering
zoom without comprehension benefit
feature-card tour without a user task

entries.title: Ideogram 4 structured typography and layout controls

principles.claim: Ideogram 4 supports structured text elements, normalized bounding boxes and element-level visual controls.
principles.evidenceLocator: Structured prompting and typography examples
principles.transferRule: Compile approved short text and layout into the Ideogram-specific adapter while retaining a deterministic overlay fallback for exact delivery copy.

principles.claim: Natural-language and structured JSON request modes are distinct provider interfaces.
principles.evidenceLocator: Ideogram 4 structured prompting and API examples
principles.transferRule: Keep typed text, bounding boxes and palettes in provider metadata; never send Ideogram JSON as a universal image prompt.

antiPatterns: provider JSON copied to another model
generated legal copy without OCR
assuming generated text uses the real brand font
long dense text without deterministic fallback

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 multimodal references, extension, and audio responsibility

principles.claim: Seedance 2.0 accepts image, video and audio references, while official guidance recommends a small role-specific set rather than filling every slot.
principles.evidenceLocator: Reference planning and prompt examples
principles.transferRule: Assign each input exactly one primary role such as identity, full-body pose, environment, camera/action rhythm or audio mood and reject conflicting role ownership.

principles.claim: The model supports continuation and editing in addition to generation.
principles.evidenceLocator: Extension and editing workflows
principles.transferRule: Persist action phase, identity, camera vector, light direction, motion energy and audio tail, then prompt the next segment to continue rather than restart.

antiPatterns: using every available reference slot
one asset controlling identity and camera motion
restarting action in an extension
letting native audio duplicate an approved TTS or music track

entries.title: Sora product and API discontinuation routing boundary

principles.claim: Sora Web and App have been discontinued and the API has a published discontinuation date.
principles.evidenceLocator: Official discontinuation schedule
principles.transferRule: Mark Sora as migration-only, reject it as a new long-lived default route, and require a live lifecycle check before any remaining API request.

antiPatterns: treating a retired product workflow as currently available
selecting an expiring API for a long-lived default
hiding lifecycle risk from budget or approval

entries.title: Resolve Remotion composition metadata before preview and render

principles.claim: Remotion can calculate duration, dimensions, frame rate, codec defaults and transformed props before a composition is rendered.
principles.evidenceLocator: calculateMetadata() return values and dynamic metadata examples
principles.transferRule: Resolve script, narration duration, assets, canvas size and props before preview; persist the resolved props hash and use it unchanged for candidate selection and final render.

principles.claim: Composition inputs and calculated metadata form an explicit render boundary rather than ambient component state.
principles.evidenceLocator: calculateMetadata() inputProps and props transformation
principles.transferRule: Validate typed scene props before rendering and reject missing media, invalid duration or unsupported aspect ratio at preflight instead of failing inside a frame render.

antiPatterns: duration guessed independently from narration
preview and final using different props
asset discovery during frame rendering
ambient mutable composition state

entries.title: Token-timed caption composition in Remotion

principles.claim: Remotion caption primitives represent text with start, end and timestamp information that can drive frame-accurate presentation.
principles.evidenceLocator: Caption data structure and caption API overview
principles.transferRule: Keep word or token timestamps as the subtitle source of truth; derive pages, current-word emphasis and frame ranges from timestamps instead of estimating from character count.

principles.claim: Caption parsing, pagination and visual rendering are separate responsibilities.
principles.evidenceLocator: Caption conversion, TikTok-style pages and display guidance
principles.transferRule: Audit transcription confidence and timing before styling; then test line breaks, multilingual typography, safe area and active-word emphasis independently.

antiPatterns: equal-duration words
subtitle timing inferred from text length
caption animation hiding low-confidence transcription
unsafe mobile line breaks

entries.title: Frame-controlled Three.js scenes in Remotion

principles.claim: Three.js scenes rendered in Remotion must follow the Remotion frame clock rather than an independent realtime animation loop.
principles.evidenceLocator: Remotion Three integration and frame rendering model
principles.transferRule: Compute camera, object, material and light state from frame, fps and seeded inputs; disable autonomous clocks and nondeterministic simulations during render.

principles.claim: 3D composition adds browser rendering cost and asset-loading constraints to each frame.
principles.evidenceLocator: Three integration setup and rendering considerations
principles.transferRule: Declare geometry, texture, shader and light budgets per scene, preload assets, and render a representative range before accepting 3D as the final route.

antiPatterns: requestAnimationFrame inside render
unseeded particles
runtime asset fetching per frame
3D spectacle without semantic purpose

entries.title: Imagen 4 deprecation and Gemini image migration boundary

principles.claim: Google marks Imagen 4 deprecated and publishes a shutdown date of August 17, 2026, with migration guidance toward Gemini 3.1 Flash Image.
principles.evidenceLocator: Imagen model lifecycle notice and migration note
principles.transferRule: Remove Imagen 4 from new default routes, expose the shutdown date in readiness and budget approvals, and revalidate the replacement model's exact image-edit and reference limits before use.

antiPatterns: choosing Imagen 4 as a new default
hiding a dated shutdown from the user
assuming migration preserves every parameter
using stale pricing after model migration

entries.title: Camera position, subject distance, and focal length form one story decision

principles.claim: Camera position, framing and subject choice are parts of visual language and should serve story and emotional meaning.
principles.evidenceLocator: Shot Craft camera-position method
principles.transferRule: Require camera height, side, azimuth, distance, focal length and narrative motivation as one executable shot contract.

principles.claim: Perspective relationships follow camera-to-subject and subject-to-background distance rather than focal length alone.
principles.evidenceLocator: ASC large-format and lens-distance explanations
principles.transferRule: Flag incompatible focal-length, distance and shot-scale declarations; do not describe every focal-length change as a perspective change.

antiPatterns: cool camera position without story meaning
focal length without distance
random scale changes
moving camera as decoration

entries.title: Real clip handles protect transitions and edit flexibility

principles.claim: Clip handles are source frames outside edit points; insufficient handles can force repeated boundary frames.
principles.evidenceLocator: Clip-handle definitions and insufficient-media behavior
principles.transferRule: Require real head and tail motion frames per shot and reject copied or frozen frames as transition handles.

antiPatterns: repeated tail frame as handle
centered transition without source overlap
provider anchor frame treated as edit point

entries.title: Design lighting for coverage and multi-camera continuity

principles.claim: A lighting setup designed for actor movement and multiple cameras can reduce adjustments and mismatched light between shots.
principles.evidenceLocator: ARRI production interview on multi-camera coverage and lighting control
principles.transferRule: Group shots by scene, key direction, color temperature and camera setup while keeping edit order separate from execution order.

antiPatterns: independent lighting prompt per shot
color temperature drift inside one scene
execution order forced to equal edit order

entries.title: First and last frame generation is a model-specific capability

principles.claim: Specific Veo model routes accept first and last frame images through an explicit provider request.
principles.evidenceLocator: Vertex AI first/last-frame request schema
principles.transferRule: Choose first/last-frame mode only after exact model capability verification; otherwise split, extend, bridge, or reroute.

antiPatterns: assuming every video model supports last frame
calling edit cut frames provider anchors
continuity route without fallback
